#api_key.title: RevenueCat API Key
#api_key.description: V2 secret key (sk_…) for the RevenueCat REST API v2. Mint one in the RevenueCat dashboard under Settings → API keys → Add new key (type: V2 Secret). Grant at minimum read scopes for all project resources.

project_id.title: Project
project_id.description: Optional — restrict extraction to one RevenueCat project. Leave empty to extract all projects the API key can access.

entities.title: Entity groups
entities.description: Which entity groups to extract. 'config' = projects/apps/products/entitlements/offerings/packages (lightweight). 'customers' = customers + active_entitlements/subscriptions/purchases/invoices (heavier fan-out, one API call per customer per entity type).

load_type.title: Load type
load_type.description: full_load re-extracts all data on every run (RevenueCat v2 has no incremental cursor, so this is the only correct mode for v1). Writes are still incremental upserts on the primary key — no duplicate rows on re-run.
